title: Cosmic Oracle Emergence
description: A surreal painting depicts a bald woman with wide eyes and an open mouth rising from a mountain range, her head surrounded by radiating black lines and floating esoteric symbols, dice, and glowing orbs. Below her is a large circular portal showing a swirling galaxy, set against a dramatic landscape of colorful crystalline mountains under a purple and blue cosmic sky with falling rain.
prompt: Surreal symbolic painting of a bald woman with wide staring eyes and open mouth emerging from jagged mountains, her head framed by radiating black lines and surrounded by floating tarot cards, polyhedral dice, glowing green orbs, and alchemical symbols against a swirling purple and blue cosmic sky with rain, a large circular galaxy portal on her chest, colorful crystalline mountains and white and blue flowers in the foreground, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere
